dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, I heard you passed your English test. Congratulations!
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, aɪ ˈhɜːrd juː ˈpæst jʊr ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˌtɛst. kənˌɡrætʃəˈleɪʃənz!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thank you! Now I'm going to study in Toronto for one semester.
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋk juː! ˈnaʊ aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈstʌdi ɪn təˈrɑːntoʊ fər ˈwʌn səˈmɛstər.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: In August, if everything goes well. I'm meeting the exchange adviser on Friday to talk about it.
dialogue.reading: ɪn ˈɔːɡəst, ɪf ˈɛvriθɪŋ ˈɡoʊz ˈwɛl. aɪm ˈmiːtɪŋ ði ɪksˈtʃeɪndʒ ədˈvaɪzər ɑːn ˈfraɪdeɪ tə ˈtɔːk əˈbaʊt ɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: My visa. If I don't get it in time, I'm not certain I can go.
dialogue.reading: maɪ ˈviːzə. ɪf aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈɡɛt ɪt ɪn ˈtaɪm, aɪm ˈnɑːt ˈsɜːrtən aɪ kən ˈɡoʊ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Is it likely that you'll get it?
dialogue.reading: ɪz ɪt ˈlaɪkli ðæt juːl ˈɡɛt ɪt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: The adviser says it's likely, but visa decisions aren't always predictable.
dialogue.reading: ði ədˈvaɪzər ˈsɛz ɪts ˈlaɪkli, bʌt ˈviːzə dɪˌsɪʒənz ˈɑːrənt ˈɔːlweɪz prɪˈdɪktəbəl.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: What do you intend to do if it's late?
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt duː juː ɪnˈtɛnd tə ˈduː ɪf ɪts ˈleɪt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I intend to change my flight and arrive a few days later. I'll go anyway!
dialogue.reading: aɪ ɪnˈtɛnd tə ˈtʃeɪndʒ maɪ ˈflaɪt ənd əˈraɪv ə ˈfjuː ˈdeɪz ˈleɪtər. aɪl ˈɡoʊ ˈɛniweɪ!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Good for you! I'll help you with the visa forms, then.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd fər ˈjuː! aɪl ˈhɛlp juː wɪð ðə ˈviːzə ˌfɔːrmz, ˈðɛn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Really? Thank you so much, Mr. Brown!
dialogue.reading: ˈriːli? ˈθæŋk juː ˈsoʊ ˈmʌtʃ, ˈmɪstər ˈbraʊn!
